Host RSS does not certify MPS driver/allocator peak memory
Detection and GUI rendering are excluded
Four concurrent source stacks alone require 11.72 GiB before traces, masks and inference
No complete-pipeline host-RSS budget has been accepted. Remote CI and licensing review before distribution remain pending.
